What upgrades have been made?

Four magnetic connectors with quick connects have been introduced.

Tips

1. The default firmware is set to I2C communication expansion mode. 
It is important to note that to expand the number of slave devices, each additional
device must have a unique I2C address.
Slave devices cannot be used independently, the correct usage is in a setup where one
master device communicates with multiple slave devices.
2.  Up to 6 devices can be connected, when connecting more than one device you need to reduce the maximum brightness of the on-board LED to 10.
3. There are some limitations on the expansion direction of the board due to the long distance wiring of the hardware. Only one device can be expanded on the left and right sides of the mainframe, and a maximum of two devices can be expanded downward (USB ports will prevent expansion). This creates a 2x3 grid layout with a total of 6 devices.
4. When running multiple boards, it is not advisable to set the brightness to maximum due to the large number of LED. (If all the LEDs are on, a lot of heat is generated, and the USB ports have limited supply current.)

products.title: T-U2T
products.body_html:
LILYGO® TTGO T-U2T USB To TTL Automatic Downloader CH9102 Programmer Adapter Serial Development Board Open Source Module


LILYGO® T-U2T USB To TTL Automatic Downloader CH9102

  • LILYGO T-U2T is the abbreviation of USB To TTL.
  • The original intention of this product design is that every time you design an ESP32 circuit board, you will find that the same circuit of USB To TTL appears on the schematic, especially when creating a small-sized circuit.
  • This circuit occupies a lot of space, and it also increases the cost, so we want to change it, Finally, we discovered that each product also has another feature that is the USB interface with TYPE-C.
  • So based on the characteristics of the male Type-c and female Type-C USB ports, we separately designed the CH9102 USB interface chip and automatic download circuit into the shape of a USB adapter.
  • We will start with new products (for example T-display e-paper version), there is no longer a duplicate USB To TTL circuit on the motherboard.
  • And you only need a T-U2T to use the LILYGO motherboard. T-U2T is also an open-source product. Other products with USB To TTL circuits can also be designed to be compatible with T-U2T.
  • This can not only save space on the circuit board but also save costs, especially in the current environment of a tight supply of chip wafers.

  • Paxcounter is an ESP32 MCU-based program for metering passenger flows in realtime. It counts how many mobile devices are around. This gives an estimation how many people are around.

Watch-Keyboard-C3 V1.0 is equipped with ESP32-C3 chip, supports WIFI and Bluetooth function, and uses a mini-pin Keyboard with QWERTY layout. It is very good for use with T-Watch or as a decoration.

Pin Diagram

  • 1 X Watch-keyboard-C3
  • 1 X Motor MIC Speaker Module
  • 1 X 0.5mm Flexible Flat Cable (1*6P)
